title: 智能体会话消息线
subTitle: 按 session_id 只读重建：started / append / snapshot / mutation

body.body: 缺少 session_id 查询参数。请从安全事件或会话事件列表中的会话号进入。

api.adaptor: var status=payload&&payload.status!==undefined?Number(payload.status):0;if(status!==0)return {status:status,msg:(payload&&payload.msg)||'会话事件查询失败',data:{}};var d=payload&&payload.data?payload.data:(payload||{}),rows=Array.isArray(d.rows)?d.rows:((d.result&&Array.isArray(d.result.rows))?d.result.rows:[]),total=Number(d.total||(d.result&&d.result.total)||rows.length);function asObject(value){if(value&&typeof value==='object')return value;if(typeof value==='string'&&value.trim()!==''){try{return JSON.parse(value);}catch(e){return null;}}return null;}function messageList(row){var value=asObject(row.messages);if(Array.isArray(value))return value;if(value&&Array.isArray(value.messages))return value.messages;return [];}function mutationOf(row){var value=asObject(row.mutation);return value&&typeof value==='object'?value:{};}function messageKey(message){if(!message||typeof message!=='object')return '';return String(message.msg_hash||message.message_id||'');}function addMessage(map,message){if(!message||typeof message!=='object')return;var key=messageKey(message);if(key)map[key]=message;}var sorted=rows.slice(0);sorted.sort(function(a,b){var ta=String(a.occurred_at||''),tb=String(b.occurred_at||'');if(ta!==tb)return ta<tb?-1:1;var ia=String(a.zenvis_insert_time||''),ib=String(b.zenvis_insert_time||'');if(ia!==ib)return ia<ib?-1:1;var ea=String(a.event_key||''),eb=String(b.event_key||'');return ea<eb?-1:(ea>eb?1:0);});var seen={},events=[];sorted.forEach(function(row){var key=String(row.event_key||'');if(!key)key=String(row.event_kind||'')+'|'+String(row.session_id||'')+'|'+String(row.occurred_at||'');if(seen[key])return;seen[key]=1;events.push(row);});var messageMap={},startedCount=0,appendCount=0,snapshotCount=0,mutationCount=0;events.forEach(function(row){var kind=String(row.event_kind||'');if(kind==='started'){startedCount++;return;}if(kind==='snapshot'){snapshotCount++;messageMap={};messageList(row).forEach(function(message){addMessage(messageMap,message);});return;}if(kind==='append'){appendCount++;messageList(row).forEach(function(message){addMessage(messageMap,message);});return;}if(kind==='mutation'){mutationCount++;var mutation=mutationOf(row),oldMessage=mutation.old||{},newMessage=mutation.new||messageList(row)[0];if(oldMessage.msg_hash)delete messageMap[String(oldMessage.msg_hash)];addMessage(messageMap,newMessage);}});var messages=[];Object.keys(messageMap).forEach(function(key){var message=messageMap[key]||{},index=(message.msg_index===null||message.msg_index===undefined)?999999:Number(message.msg_index);messages.push({message_id:String(message.message_id||''),msg_index:index,msg_hash:String(message.msg_hash||''),role:String(message.role||''),original:(message.original===undefined?null:message.original)});});messages.sort(function(a,b){if(a.msg_index!==b.msg_index)return a.msg_index-b.msg_index;return a.message_id<b.message_id?-1:(a.message_id>b.message_id?1:0);});var eventRows=events.map(function(row){return{zenvis_id:row.zenvis_id,event_key:row.event_key,occurred_at:row.occurred_at,event_kind:row.event_kind,message_count:Number(row.message_count||0),msg_index:row.msg_index,request_path:row.request_path,request_wire:row.request_wire};}),truncated=total>rows.length,warnings=[];if(!events.length)warnings.push('未查询到当前会话的会话流事件；请确认会话号正确、ai-agent-chat-message 有消息，且「Sentinel会话事件解析入库」任务已启用');else if(startedCount===0)warnings.push('未找到 started 事件，消息线可能不完整');if(startedCount>1)warnings.push('检测到多条不同 started 事件，请核对上游契约');if(truncated)warnings.push('事件总数超过单页上限，当前仅加载前 '+rows.length+' 条，消息线可能不完整');var pageSessionId=api&&api.data?String(api.data.session_id||''):'';return {status:0,msg:'',data:{has_data:events.length>0,session_id:pageSessionId||String((events[0]&&events[0].session_id)||''),event_total:total,event_count:events.length,started_count:startedCount,append_count:appendCount,snapshot_count:snapshotCount,mutation_count:mutationCount,message_count:messages.length,messages:messages,event_rows:eventRows,truncated:truncated,warnings:warnings,warning_text:warnings.join('；')}};

messages.fetchFailed: 会话事件查询失败，请核对 session_id 或访问权限

body.body: 消息线按事件幂等键去重，并按到达顺序应用 append / snapshot / mutation；只读展示，不回写上游。若上游使用 snapshot 模式，snapshot 会覆盖此前的全量视图。
